changelog.title: QR artwork with styled modules and finders
changelog.summary: Module shapes, finder frames and palettes configured apart from encoding, with scan heuristics.

changelog.title: One scanner for every family
changelog.summary: SymbolScanner finds QR, Data Matrix, Aztec and linear codes in one image, with limits and status.

changelog.title: Code 39 character patterns corrected
changelog.summary: Standard Code 39 bars now match the specification for every character.

changelog.title: GS1 DataBar Expanded, reimplemented
changelog.summary: Rewritten encoder with better SVG interoperability.

changelog.title: Micro QR, complete
changelog.summary: All M1 to M4 sizes, encoded and recognized from images.

changelog.title: Industrial and logistics barcodes
changelog.summary: ITF-14 and the 2 of 5 family for cartons and pallets.

changelog.title: Data Matrix generation fixed
changelog.summary: Correct symbols across sizes, plus matrix render helpers.

changelog.title: Transparent backgrounds
changelog.summary: QR codes on a transparent background composite correctly.

changelog.title: QR codes in the console
changelog.summary: ASCII output that terminals and logs can show.

changelog.title: Connected modules and the QR art API
changelog.summary: ConnectedSquircle modules, art presets and canvas frames.

changelog.title: First release
changelog.summary: QR, linear and 2D codes in pure managed .NET.
